**Endpoints:**

- **`POST /api/ticket/classify`** — Predicts category (`Billing`/`Technical`/`General`) with per-class confidence scores. Validates priority (1–3) and requires subject or description.
- **`GET /api/ticket/metrics`** — Returns cross-validated evaluation metrics (macro/micro accuracy, log-loss, log-loss reduction).

**ML Pipeline:** Featurizes Subject + Description text, concatenates with Priority, trains an SDCA Maximum Entropy multiclass classifier, and uses 3-fold cross-validation for robust metrics on the small dataset.
